mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
